evidence.command: Independent read-only audit of build, package, path, process, manifest, rollback, and verification patterns
facts: A version-pinned Bun CLI is the best fit for one-command bootstrap without adding a critical-path shell script.
The recommended UX is bunx --bun @ghashtag/trios-installer@<exact-version> install.
The installer should build in staging, verify exact commits and the bundle, then atomically promote a current release pointer.
A rerun of the same manifest should verify and no-op.
Failure before promotion must preserve the active installation; failure after promotion must restore the previous release.

residual_risks: The publishable installer package and signed immutable release manifest do not exist yet.
Successful clean installation remains blocked by unpublished Queen and mesh inputs.
The final managed source location and update behavior still need design approval.
